learning_objective: 🎯 Let us group our naming words into boy families and girl families!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Masculine nouns are names for boys, men, and male animals. Words like father, king, brother, and lion belong to this group.
Feminine nouns are names for girls, women, and female animals. Words like mother, queen, sister, and lioness belong to this group.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Gender Match-Up Game!
fun_activity.instructions: Draw lines to match the pairs! Write boy words on the left (Prince, Uncle, Tiger) and girl words on the right (Aunt, Tigress, Princess) and connect the families.

quick_recap: ⭐ Nouns can tell us if someone is male or female.
⭐ Masculine nouns are for boys and men.
⭐ Feminine nouns are for girls and women.
⭐ Animals have gender names too, like rooster and hen!
